sample.headline: Under 1.5 shots is a price play the projection doesn't back
sample.reason: This is a price bet, not a projection bet: the Bot projects Egor Chinakhov for 1.86 shots, above the under 1.5, and both BOS's defense and the game script push his number up 3.2% each. What keeps the under alive is that it only needs him held to one shot or none, and his last 5 games averaged 1.38, though the fit counts that recent form at just 20%. His weighted history lands under this line 42.31% of the time, barely past break-even. The Book's no-vig chance is 40.59%, and the desk bets 40.64% against a 40% break-even at +150, an edge of 0.64 points, with the Bot and the market nearly in agreement. And this side's record, 132 won and 148 lost over 280 graded bets, is down 14.3 units.
sample.risk: With Bryan Rust out and the Bot already projecting 1.86, two routine shots on goal beat this; the projection itself sits on the over side of the line.

sample.headline: Under 1.5 shots is a price play, not a projection call
sample.reason: This is a price bet more than a projection bet: the Bot projects Kent Johnson for 1.61 shots, a hair above the line, so the under 1.5 rests on +128 paying more than his chance needs. DAL's defense counts for -5.5% and the game script, with CBJ expected to score 2.9, for -2.7%, pulling his blended rate of 1.76 down toward the line. His last 5 games averaged 1.18, but the fit gives that only 20% weight, and just 46% of his 51 weighted games landed under. The Book's no-vig chance is 45.2%, and the desk bets 45.3% against a 43.86% break-even, an edge of 1.44 points that comes from the Book's own price, not from the Bot. Also worth knowing: this desk has 132 won and 148 lost on this type and side.
sample.risk: His projection of 1.61 sits over the line, so two routine shots beat this; the edge is only 1.44 points and comes from the price, not from a read on him.

sample.headline: Joseph Woll over 22.5 saves, but the edge is mostly price
sample.reason: The projection likes this more than the price does. His blended rate is 27.48 saves a game, and even after the opponent driver takes 9.4% off for the low shot volume goalies face against NYR, the Bot projects 24.8, over 22.5, with 84% of his weighted games on this side. But the fit runs high on saves by 0.492 across all players, and when it gave this side about 64% it hit only 58%, so the projection oversells itself. The Bot's own chance is just 51.76% against the Book's no-vig 51.47%; the desk bets 51.49% against a 50.5% break-even, an edge of 0.995 points that comes from the Book's price rather than the projection. Also, this type and side is 6-12 across 18 graded bets, a hint and not evidence.
sample.risk: If NYR keeps shot volume as low as the 9.4% opponent cut implies, Woll falls short of 22.5, and a fit that runs high on saves leaves almost no cushion at this price.
